name: pixel-liquid-bg

frames.best_why: Large pink fluid forms are at their fullest, with the blocky dithering clearly visible across the frame.
frames.render_note: The fluid fills the stage, but the demo headline is squeezed into a clipped strip at the right edge.

tagline: Pink liquid churns across black in chunky, dithered blocks.
summary: A near-black backdrop where a pink fluid simulation is stirred by the pointer and then rendered as large dithered blocks with faint grain, so the motion reads as low-resolution liquid.
appearance: A black stage with blooms of hot pink and magenta, each visibly built from square blocks with soft dithered edges. A light noise grain covers the surface and the shapes fade out into the surrounding darkness.
behaviour: The fluid never rests: the pointer pushes and folds it, and when the pointer is idle an auto-driver keeps it wandering. Blobs stretch, curl and dissolve while the block grid stays fixed over them.
demo_content: "Liquid, one pixel at a time" heading with a small Move your cursor caption.
search_phrases: pink fluid swirling on a black background
melty lava lamp backdrop for a hero
interactive goo that follows the mouse
dark page background with moving pink blobs
webgl fluid simulation as a page backdrop
use_when: A hero or page background should feel alive and tactile, and hot pink liquid suits a bold dark theme.
avoid_when: It is a WebGL sim running every frame, the palettes are fixed pink, and it needs a container with real height.
customise: Set darkPalette and lightPalette colour stops, pixelSize for the block grid, resolution, mouseForce and cursorSize, and turn off the idle driver with autoDemo. Children render above the canvas.
weight_why: A full WebGL fluid sim with eight pressure iterations and a fragment pass every frame.

a11y.note: The constant motion ignores prefers-reduced-motion and the canvas offers no keyboard or screen-reader path.

issues: The demo headline is crushed into a narrow strip and clipped at the right edge, making it unreadable.
Frames 1 and 3 are close to empty black, so the effect can sit nearly invisible between bursts.
polish_why: Rich dithered fluid with a believable loop; overlay text is clipped and the palette fixed.
